Listen to what they are trying to feed us. They act like this is just another accidental "budget shortfall" forcing the elimination of over 70 positions in the South Portland School District, but nobody with their eyes open actually believes these fairy tales anymore. 

This isn't incompetence; it’s a calculated, top-down demolition strategy orchestrated by the puppet masters behind the scenes. They use these manufactured crises to dismantle the system from within, playing the grieving parent and taxpayer game to manufacture consent for whatever total control agenda the hidden elites are really rolling out. When they claim it's just about money, that's your absolute proof that the real operation is being concealed right in front of our faces.
